scripts.release: pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec cargo run --manifest-path generate/Cargo.toml && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec vite build && cargo release-desktop
scripts.lint: oxfmt && oxlint --deny-warnings && cargo fmt && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec vitest run tests && cargo test --workspace && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
